newsitem.title: USA: Reptron amends offering to 2.0 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Reptron amends offering to 2.0 mln shrs.

text.p: Reptron Electronics Inc said on Thursday it filed an amendment to decrease the size of its proposed public offering to two million shares of common stock from three million shares.
The issue will consists of 1.5 million shares to be offered by the company and 500,000 shares to be offered by a selling shareholder.

Reptron said that the estimated net proceeds to the company from the offering are expected to be reduced by $18 million. The company intends to use its proceeds from the offering to reduce amounts outstanding on its revolving credit agreement.

Reptron expects that after application of its net proceeds from the offering, the outstanding amounts under its revolving credit agreement will be $23 million, compared with the $5 million originally planned.
Prudential Securities Inc will serve as the lead managing underwriter for the offering.
